execution.memory_estimate_scope: Known simulation buffers, worker workspaces, pinned results, scratch and 96 MiB reserve; excludes browser overhead and JavaScript heaps. This is not an OS process memory cap.

us_stocks.definition: Calendar-year S&P 500 dividends divided by beginning-year S&P index level. Income share of total return.

us_bonds.definition: 10-year constant-maturity Treasury par yield, used as an income proxy for a par Treasury portfolio. Not existing holdings’ coupon income or added return.

usd_cny.definition: Latest available daily CNY per USD observation.

cn_cpi.definition: China annual-average CPI percentage change, divided by 100.

us_cpi.definition: Latest monthly US non-seasonally-adjusted CPI relative to the same month one year earlier. Historical rows use December-to-December change.

scope: NYU/FRED historical market reference; source registry lists the checked tax subset and remaining open legal sources
